claims: The 98th Academy Awards honor 2025 films.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony takes place on March 15, 2026.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony takes place at the Dolby Theatre at Ovation Hollywood.
"Sinners" received a record 16 nominations for the 98th Academy Awards.
"Frankenstein" received nine nominations for the 98th Academy Awards.
"Sinners" is directed by Ryan Coogler.
"Frankenstein" is directed by Guillermo del Toro.
"Frankenstein" is a Netflix-produced adaptation.
Jacob Elordi received acting nominations for "Frankenstein" for the 98th Academy Awards.
"F1" stars Brad Pitt.
"F1" is recognized for sound for the 98th Academy Awards.
"F1" is recognized for visual effects for the 98th Academy Awards.
"Hamnet" received a Best Director nomination for Chloé Zhao for the 98th Academy Awards.
"Marty Supreme" is a directorial effort from Josh Safdie.
"Sentimental Value" is a Norwegian film.
"Sentimental Value" is recognized for its screenplay.
"Bugonia" is directed by Yorgos Lanthimos.
"Bugonia" stars Emma Stone.
Renate Reinsve is nominated for Best Actress for "Sentimental Value" for the 98th Academy Awards.
Emma Stone is nominated for Best Actress for "Bugonia" for the 98th Academy Awards.
Jacob Elordi is nominated for a supporting role for "Frankenstein" for the 98th Academy Awards.
Benicio Del Toro is nominated for a supporting role for "One Battle After Another" for the 98th Academy Awards.
Amy Madigan is nominated for a supporting role for "Weapons" for the 98th Academy Awards.
Wunmi Mosaku is nominated for a supporting role for "Sinners" for the 98th Academy Awards.
Chloé Zhao is nominated for Best Director for "Hamnet" for the 98th Academy Awards.
Josh Safdie is nominated for Best Director for "Marty Supreme" for the 98th Academy Awards.
Paul Thomas Anderson is nominated for Best Director for "One Battle After Another" for the 98th Academy Awards.
Joachim Trier is nominated for Best Director for "Sentimental Value" for the 98th Academy Awards.
Ryan Coogler is nominated for Best Director for "Sinners" for the 98th Academy Awards.
Animated Feature nominees for the 98th Academy Awards include Zootopia 2, Elio, and Arco.
Netflix is heavily featured with "Frankenstein" and "Train Dreams".
Best Picture nominees for the 98th Academy Awards include Bugonia, F1, Hamnet, Marty Supreme, The Secret Agent, Sentimental Value, and Train Dreams.
